name: angular-memory-leak-detector-compat-ng21
description: The compat app (../app) on Angular 21, for the Playwright suite in ../../e2e.

scripts.start:production: ng build --configuration production-detector --output-path dist/production-detector --progress=false && ng-leak-names dist/production-detector --quiet && node ../../scripts/serve-static.mjs dist/production-detector
scripts.start:production-minified: ng build --configuration production-detector --output-path dist/production-minified --progress=false && node ../../scripts/serve-static.mjs dist/production-minified
